name: Zoom (macOS)
description: Optimized for Zoom on macOS - normal level with full screen auxiliary support
explanation: Zoom's screen sharing relies on CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo which requires windows to be in the normal window layer (macos_floating_level=false). Window cycle participation (macos_participates_in_cycle=true) ensures Zoom's window picker can enumerate it. Sharing type 1 allows Zoom's screen recording permissions to access the window content. This configuration balances visibility with non-intrusive behavior.
